definitions.explanation: Reproduction in the full range of colors, as opposed to black-and-white or a limited palette. Used of printing, displays, and images.

examples.japanese: フルカラーで{印刷|いんさつ}する。
この{冊子|さっし}はフルカラーで{見|み}やすい。
examples.english: This booklet is in full color and easy to read.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{白黒|しろくろ}だった{漫画|まんが}が、フルカラー{版|ばん}で{復刊|ふっかん}された。
examples.english: A manga that used to be black-and-white was reissued in a full-color edition.

notes:
A loanword from English "full color," contrasting with {白黒|しろくろ} (black-and-white) or {単色|たんしょく} (monochrome). Frequently used of printing, screens, and illustrations. Often used attributively before another noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フルカラー{印刷|いんさつ}: full-color printing
- フルカラー{液晶|えきしょう}: full-color LCD
- フルカラーで{表示|ひょうじ}する: to display in full color

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {白黒|しろくろ}: black-and-white — the opposite
- モノクロ: monochrome — single-color reproduction, another antonym
